instruction: A warehouse starts with 1055 boxes. It receives 2 deliveries of 48 boxes each. It ships 12 boxes per day for 3 days. It receives 2 deliveries of 60 boxes each. It ships 17 boxes per day for 3 days. Then the stock is split equally into 0 warehouses and it keeps one share (rounded down). How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory.
